chunks: If you falter even after Our signs have reached you, then do not forget that God is all-powerful and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when believers falter after receiving clear signs from God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from the certainty of prophetic guidance to the potential for human error, emphasizing that divine wisdom governs the consequences of such slips. It serves as a reminder that while God’s might ensures the ultimate establishment of truth, His wisdom dictates the timing and manner of accountability, encouraging believers to remain vigilant after receiving clear proofs.
